item.description:
publications

Self-archived publication material

My research software projects have been published in CRAN, Bioconductor, Julia and Github, with altogether 100,000+ downloads per year, and include two international data science developer networks that I coordinate and lead, each encompassing multiple software packages. The projects listed below are mature and many of them are associated with peer-reviewed publications, grants and awards. I am the main developer or a major co-developer in all listed cases.

  • rOpenGov (R; ropengov.org) — open government data analytics: 10+ R/CRAN packages, of which the most downloaded are listed below. Reproducible online tutorials are available for most packages through the individual package websites linked at the project homepage.

Publications / Leo Lahti

Publication material of our research group is collected in this folder.

  • Presentation material in UTU Gitlab
  • Some slides also available through SlideShare

Note that the copyrights may differ by publication.
